assumptions: USD million. Fictional Moss Harbor Hospital. Toy contractual adjustments reduce service consideration; ECL applies to billed net receivables only. No opening allowance changes beyond specified writeoff/recovery.

evidence.text:
[Payer statement]
|Payer|Gross charges|Contractual reduction|Cash received against current bills|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|Public|180|60|105|
|Private|150|30|95|
|Self-pay|40|10|20|
[Opening receivables] 25, cash receipts on opening bills 15, writeoffs 4; no other AR movements. All current net consideration invoiced.

[Closing gross aging]
|Bucket|Net-of-contractual gross AR|ECL rate|
|---|---:|---:|
|Current|35|1%|
|31-90 days|15|5%|
|Over 90 days|16|40%|
[Allowance] Opening ECL allowance 5; writeoffs 4 use allowance; no recoveries. Current charge balances to required closing amount.
[P&L] Direct cost 190, admin 40. No tax. Draft treats contractual reductions as ECL and uses gross charges for revenue.
[Audit] If AR bridge differs from the aging total, flag discrepancy, do not invent adjustment.

qas.question: Net earned hospital revenue từ ba payer groups?
AR bridge trước khi đối chiếu aging?
Aging table tổng gross AR là bao nhiêu?
Closing ECL theo aging table, conditional bảng được xác nhận đúng?
Incremental ECL charge nếu dùng approved aging target 7,5?
Có thể công bố net AR 58,5 như đã reconciled không?
qas.answer: Không. 66−7,5=58,5 chỉ theo aging; bridge gross56 chưa khớp. Phải xác minh missing movement 10 trước khi khẳng định final.

qas.question: Tại sao contractual reduction100 không phải ECL charge?
qas.answer: Là chênh gross charges với agreed consideration, giảm revenue; ECL đo credit loss trên quyền thu đã ghi.

qas.question: Có tính exact final net AR từ evidence mâu thuẫn mà không đặt giả định?
qas.answer: Không. Cần reconciled ledger/aging và xác nhận khoản chênh 10.

assumptions: USD million; thousand shipments. Fictional Pine Way Freight. Toy each route earned base freight + surcharge, all principal. Base tariff and costs in listed currency; translate EUR at stipulated average rate.

evidence.text:

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
|Domestic|100|500|80|420|USD|
|Europe|60|600|100|520|EUR|
|Asia|80|400|60|360|USD|
[FX] Average USD/EUR 1.20; closing 1.25 only for monetary balances. Prior average1.10, current output unchanged for constant-currency comparison.
[Corporate] Central fixed expense 15m USD, no depreciation or tax.
[Receivables] EUR route billed AR closing EUR8m, no allowance; USD route AR closing USD10m. These are local currency balances.
[KPI] Constant-currency current margin retranslates current EUR revenue and cost at prior average rate, no other adjustment.

qas.question: Europe earned revenue quy USD theo average rate?
Reported consolidated freight revenue?
Direct contribution Europe theo average FX?
Group operating profit reported sau central?
Closing AR consolidated quy closing FX?
Constant currency current EBIT dùng prior average FX1.10?
Tại sao không dùng closing rate cho annual Europe route P&L?
qas.answer: Policy dùng average cho flow, closing cho monetary stock. Đảo hai rate làm sai cả earnings và AR.

qas.question: Có tính YoY constant-currency growth từ current restated profit không?
qas.answer: Không. Thiếu prior P&L profit/revenue thực tế cùng phạm vi.

assumptions: USD million; thousand subscribers. Fictional Reed Wave. Toy active paying SIMs distinct from registered SIMs; ARPU based on average paying SIMs and service revenue excluding equipment. No acquisition.

evidence.text:
[Subscriber bridge]
|Cohort|Opening paying k|Gross activations k|Deactivations k|Average paying k|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|Prepaid|800|250|180|820|
|Postpaid|400|100|50|430|

[Revenue]
|Cohort|Annual service revenue m|Handset revenue m|
|---|---:|---:|
|Prepaid|98.4|20|
|Postpaid|154.8|60|

[Definition] Monthly blended ARPU = total annual service revenue / average paying SIMs /12. Deactivation rate in this case = annual deactivations/opening paying SIMs, not standard monthly churn. Registered year-end SIMs 1,800k includes inactive.
[Cost] Service direct cost 120m, handset COGS65m, central expense80m. No other charges.
[Memo] Management uses registered ending SIMs to divide total revenue including handsets, labels monthly ARPU; says prepaid gross adds equal net adds.
[Disclosure] No month-level deactivation timing or unique-person count.

qas.question: Closing paying prepaid SIMs từ bridge?
Net adds company-wide gồm hai cohorts?
Blended monthly service ARPU theo average paying SIMs?
Annual prepaid deactivation rate theo stipulated metric?
Reported operating profit sau service cost và handset COGS?
Nêu hai mismatch trong ARPU của deck.
qas.answer: Numerator gồm handset one-time, denominator là registered ending thay average paying. Correct metric dùng service revenue và average paying, chia 12.

qas.question: Có xác định monthly churn bằng 22,5%/12?
qas.answer: Không chính xác. Annual opening-based deactivation rate không phải monthly churn; thiếu monthly base và timing.

qas.question: Có đồng nhất net paying SIMs120k với 120k unique new people không?
qas.answer: Không. Một người có thể nhiều SIM; deactivation và activation là SIM counts, không unique customer.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Alder Air. Toy revenue when flights performed; refund settlement separate; vouchers remain obligations. Interline agent amounts excluded from own passenger sales.

evidence.text:
[Ticket liability roll-forward]
|Item|Amount|
|---|---:|
|Opening own ticket liability|60|
|Current own ticket sales cash|300|
|Flown service from opening|50|
|Flown service from current|240|
|Current unused ticket cash refunds|12|
|Current unused tickets converted to vouchers|18|

[Voucher] Opening voucher liability 8; redeemed voucher service 5, expired confirmed 2. Current conversion18 moves liability from ticket to voucher; no additional revenue. No cash on redemption/expiry.
[Interline] Agent sells partner tickets cash40, remits30, retains fee4 earned. Opening partner payable3; no other amounts.
[Expenses] Own passenger service costs 210, selling/admin45, both expense. No tax/interest. No partner flight cost beyond agency payable.
[Accounting] Report own flown and voucher redeemed/expiry as revenue, fee separate. Ticket and voucher liability gross; no interline netting.
[Draft] CFO includes all cash own and partner ticket sales in revenue and removes voucher conversion from total obligations.

qas.question: Closing own ticket liability không gồm vouchers?
Closing voucher liability theo voucher bridge?
Total earned own passenger revenue gồm voucher activities?
Ending partner payable từ agency ticket sale?
Operating profit gồm agency fee và own costs?
Vì sao conversion18 không làm total customer liability giảm?

qas.question: Có đưa partner cash40 vào passenger revenue?

qas.question: Có tính future redemption probability của voucher19?
qas.answer: Không. Không có expiry terms theo cohort hoặc redemption history.

assumptions: USD million; thousand tonnes. Fictional Willow Rice Mill. Toy grain purchases wet weight, dry inventory after processing, normal moisture loss absorbed into saleable dry grain cost. Byproduct revenue separately earned, no abnormal waste.

evidence.text:
[Input table]
|Lot|Wet tonnes k|Cost $/wet t|Dry yield|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|North|100|180|.80|
|South|80|200|.75|
[Processing] All wet grain processed. Common cash drying/milling cost 4m allocated over total dry output; no opening dry stock. Weighted average dry grain cost.
[Sales] Sell 110k dry tonnes at $380/t. Remaining dry stock NRV $300/t. Byproduct sale2m, byproduct cost already included in common cost, no separate credit to grain cost under toy.
[Operating] Central expense3m; no tax or interest. All dry grain sales collected; no other revenue.
[Policy] Lower of weighted dry cost and NRV on closing quantity; no valuation above cost. Normal weight loss not separate expense.
[Deck] Manager divides purchase cost by wet tonnes and assigns same wet unit cost to dry stock.

qas.question: Dry grain output total từ hai wet lots?
Total cost pool của dry grain trước sale?
Weighted average cost mỗi dry tonne?
Closing dry inventory carrying sau NRV test?
qas.answer: 30k×271,428571/1000≈8,142857 triệu USD; cost thấp hơn NRV300.

qas.question: Operating result gồm byproduct revenue và allocated dry COGS?
Tại sao dùng wet tonnes làm denominator cost per dry tonne sai?
qas.answer: Dry output nhỏ hơn do normal moisture loss; cost pool phải phân bổ trên 140k saleable dry tonnes, không 180k wet.

qas.question: Có cần write-up dry inventory tới NRV300?
qas.answer: Không. Cost271,43 thấp hơn NRV300; giữ cost theo lower-of rule.

qas.question: Có tách profit riêng North và South dry rice từ pooled sales?
qas.answer: Không. Sales không trace theo lot và processing cost pooled.

assumptions: USD million; thousand ore tonnes and thousand metal tonnes. Fictional Quartz Hollow. Toy recoverable payable metal per ore lot = ore×grade×recovery×payability. Royalties based on gross payable metal revenue; no inventory.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

[Price] Payable metal sold at $8,000/t, all sold and accepted. Treatment charge $300 per payable metal tonne, deducted from gross sale consideration in toy.
